meta.title: Partner with us · המשך תנועה
meta.description: Companies, organizations and foundations: partner with us through meeting sponsorship, corporate giving, speakers and coaches. Let's talk.

hero.title: Let's build a partnership
hero.body: We're looking for partners for the road ahead: from today's meetings to a nationwide network of community centers.

items.title: Steady activity
items.body: Three Friday mornings every month, plus evenings and other meetings.

items.title: A clear direction
items.body: A nationwide network of local community centers.

items.title: Straightforward
items.body: We'll gladly show you our activity, our team and our plans, and shape a partnership that fits you.

ways.title: Ways to partner
ways.body: Every partnership starts with a conversation. These are the ways to begin:

items.title: Sponsor a meeting
items.body: Fund a full Friday morning: the workout, the coffee and the talk.

items.title: Corporate donation
items.body: A one-time or recurring gift to our activity.

items.title: Speakers and coaches
items.body: Someone on your team with something to offer? Every Friday morning includes a guest talk and a movement session.

items.title: Foundations
items.body: We'd be glad to meet and walk you through our activity and plans.

ways.message: Hi, I'd like to talk with המשך תנועה about: {model}.

contact.title: Let's talk
contact.body: Tell us who you are and what interests you. We'll get back to you.
